verdict.rationale: Meltano documents a Singer SDK for hand-building connectors and lets users build and debug connectors directly, but nothing in the evidence shows AI drafting a connector (auth, pagination, streams) from API documentation. The SDK is a developer building block, not the AI-assisted capability itself. AI-assisted connector generation is a fair axis for an ELT/connector platform, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship
